objs.name: document
objs.description: Central managed information object representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, and other controlled documents in the system.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type-based abbreviation prefix assigned to the document (e.g., RL for guideline).

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: System-assigned sequential number for the document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document, incremented on each revision or edit cycle.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document within the status network (e.g., editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope designation printed in the document via TAG technology.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is considered valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus the validity period.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable time period (default 3 years) after which the document must be reviewed for continued validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable retention period (default 10 years) for archived documents before physical deletion.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content (e.g., Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute linking the document to other documents or master data.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute linking the document to relevant IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute specifying relevant companies the document applies to.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute specifying organizational or geographic areas where the document is valid.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person registered as the primary author responsible for the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional persons assigned write permissions on the document alongside the author.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to technically and formally review the document content.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person(s) responsible for approving and releasing the document for distribution.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment controlling which readers may view the released document.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute controlling email notification distribution upon release of a new version.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute controlling acknowledgement-based distribution upon release of a new version.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: The language in which the document was originally created.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of which clients in a multi-client system may view the document.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification category that determines the level and type of a document (e.g., policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Language-independent abbreviation code for the document type (e.g., RL for guideline).

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Default period for validity extension checks, configurable per document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Default archival retention period, configurable per document type.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new document objects, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata printing.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document appended to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document's release cycle.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary information object appended to a document that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and can be published directly.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal proposal for changing an existing released document, managed in the document cockpit and tracked through to implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, triggering a workflow to extend, revise, or invalidate the document.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request to invalidate a released document and initiate the archiving process, created by users with write access.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document, restricted to the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who interacts with the system in various roles such as author, reviewer, releaser, reader, or translator.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used for assigning authorizations, distribution, and role-based access to documents.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process that manages approval steps including creation, review, and release with electronic signatures.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Digital signature applied by workflow participants to confirm completion of their workflow task, documented per released version.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement distribution upon release.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Active confirmation by a recipient on the distribution list that they have read and noted a released document version.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity within the company to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process that can be linked to documents and used for process-specific document filing.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk object that can be linked to documents via master data references.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: An IT application master data object that can be referenced by documents.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific interface displaying relevant documents, tasks, and evaluation information based on distribution group assignments.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation providing filtered results lists of documents based on selection parameters and criteria.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Classification of the report such as Status Report, Document Monitoring, or Acknowledgement Report.

attributes.name: selection_parameters
attributes.description: Configurable filter criteria influencing evaluation results.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant or organizational unit in a multi-client system where document visibility can be controlled.

objs.name: translation
objs.description: A language-dependent version of a released document that must go through its own review and release workflow before becoming visible.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document content is translated.
